title: Fair Supervised Learning with A Simple Random Sampler of Sensitive Attributes
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. The benchmarks measure fairness with respect to sensitive attributes such as race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research. The study focuses on algorithmic fairness with respect to attributes like race, gender, and age in supervised learning.
